scripts.setup: npm install && uv sync --directory apps/api && uv run --directory apps/api playwright install chromium && ([ -f apps/api/.env ] || cp apps/api/.env.example apps/api/.env)
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,worker,public -c blue,magenta,green npm:dev:api npm:dev:worker npm:dev:public
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:migrate && uv run --directory apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --directory apps/api watchfiles --filter python "celery -A app.celery_app worker --pool=threads --concurrency=2 -Q celery,light --loglevel=info" app
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.workspace:create: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli create-workspace
scripts.workspace:team: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli add-my-team
scripts.user:create: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli create-user
scripts.user:deactivate: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli deactivate-user
scripts.user:activate: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli activate-user
scripts.data:import: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli import-tickdata
scripts.data:rebuild: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli rebuild-tickdata
scripts.data:cstat: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli import-cstat
scripts.review:fit: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli fit-winprob
scripts.review:rebuild: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.cli rebuild-reviews
scripts.openapi: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.openapi && npm run gen:api -w public
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:public
scripts.lint:api: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:public: npm run lint -w public && npm run typecheck -w public
